note: Dune outlines from NASADEM (SRTM, Feb 2000), kept only where NASADEM resolves the dune (DEM shading matches the 2000-11-27 Landsat image; crest >= 7.6 m above its surroundings = 3 x DEM noise). Positions moved to 2025-11-08 by the measured Landsat 8/9 2013-2025 velocity. Motion below the detection limit: below_detection_limit = true, speed_med_myr = 0, speed_lo_myr = 0, speed_hi_myr = detection limit, heading_deg = null, wind_agreement_deg = null (no direction can be measured). Classes are relative to this field: stable = below detection limit, slow < 1.40, active < 2.25, fast >= 2.25 m/yr. Smaller dunes are not outlined; their motion is in vectors.geojson. Computed by pipeline/02_tracking_and_dunes.ipynb. Threat fields computed by pipeline/03_threats_and_frames.ipynb (see threat_definition).

properties.motion_scale_note: motion measured in 480 m windows within 120 m of the outline: it includes the sand surface and smaller dunes on and around this dune, not only the dune body
properties.height_source: NASADEM (SRTM, Feb 2000), crest minus local base
properties.outline_source: NASADEM watershed, upper half of the dune body
properties.threat_basis: straight-line distance only: nothing lies along the measured heading within the fast-case reach by 2100; target R043-05
properties.threat_definition: threat = the fast case (speed + 1 sigma) of this dune's measured motion carries its outline onto a target footprint by 2050; reach years: fast case over the shortest plausible gap (min), slow case (speed - 1 sigma) over the longest (max)
